model_output:
```sql
WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM parks
  WHERE park_name ILIKE 'Miramiguoa Park' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Missouri'
)
SELECT MIN(rast_val) AS min_elevation
FROM (
  SELECT ST_Value(rast, 1, (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM park_geom), TRUE))).geom) AS rast_val
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM park_geom))
) subquery;
```
